prompt: A rectangular prism is $4 \times 3 \times 2$. Find its surface area.
hint: A rectangular prism has three different sizes of face, and each size appears twice, on opposite sides.

hints.text: A rectangular prism has three different sizes of face, and each size appears twice, on opposite sides.
The three face areas are $4 \times 3 = 12$, $4 \times 2 = 8$ and $3 \times 2 = 6$. Add them, then double the sum for the matching opposite faces.
$2(12 + 8 + 6) = 2 \times 26 = 52$, so the surface area is $52$ square units.

explanation: The prism has three pairs of matching faces, so find one face from each pair.
Multiply the dimensions two at a time to get the face areas: $4 \times 3 = 12$, $4 \times 2 = 8$ and $3 \times 2 = 6$.
Add the areas of the three different faces: $12 + 8 + 6 = 26$.
Each face has a twin on the opposite side, so double the sum: $2 \times 26 = 52$.
The surface area of the prism is $52$ square units.
